title: Decision hand-over (stage skill -> record-dec)
description: Everything record-dec needs to render templates/dec.rst nested inside target_need. The stage skill fills every field from its own work and the user's approval; record-dec adds nothing.

target_need.description: Id of the need the decision is nested in (the parent).

title.description: A few words naming what is decided.

chosen.description: The chosen option (goes into the Rationale).

rationale.description: One sentence: why the chosen option beats the alternatives.

decides.description: Needs the decision decides; must contain target_need. No dec ids. Usually just [target_need]: the nested decision then decides its parent automatically (no :decides: written). With further ids, record-dec writes :decides: with all of them.
